    • getElementNameForCollectionField

      public static String getElementNameForCollectionField(org.codehaus.groovy.ast.FieldNode fieldNode)
      Returns the name of a single element for a collection or map field. This is either taken from the Field.members() annotation member or derived from the field name (i.e. removing a trailing 's').
      Parameters:
      fieldNode - the field to get the element name for
      Returns:
      the element name
